verdict: Original S05 quality receives bounded constructive support. The exact original ST stance, native camera/body compensation, actual unrefreshed-look charged-shot success and lawful public menu/control path suffice without a new VM hit or whole victory.
independent_checks: 22 native source and2 public adapter pins verified; frozen calculation exactly reproduced; all30 focus-to-target XY segments avoid every original solid footprint. The original native31-81tick unrefreshed-look operations support the dynamic mechanical bridge. Ordinary slow walking, public integer-coordinate transitions and after-charge body/reticle reacquisition are not private position feeds.

camera_height_correction.supersedes: Any reading of the frozen bridge's2.45m focus height or7.45/8.45m example heights as fixed actual heights.
camera_height_correction.native_formula: scene/mod.rs adds -sin(min(tilt,0))*camera_distance*0.6 to the base focus height. This is a nonnegative orientation-dependent lift.
camera_height_correction.scope: The examples use baseline heights, not recorded native camera heights. The independently checked XY segments miss all original solid footprints, so the extra lift does not invalidate the terrain-visibility argument. It must not be silently omitted when reconstructing an actual camera pose.

public_body_orientation_guard.source: voxygen/src/hud/mod.rs2858-2864 displays actual body Ori, not camera yaw.
public_body_orientation_guard.observable_guard: Displayed outward body-orientation component at least0.90.
public_body_orientation_guard.rounding_bound: The native display has two decimals, so the underlying outward component is at least0.895.
public_body_orientation_guard.stance_condition: Inside distance a<=0.35m, established through the public pose/control procedure rather than inferred from the integer HUD alone.
public_body_orientation_guard.limit: This supplies a concrete public release guard instead of requiring exact orientation convergence. It is not a claim that the guard or proposed positioning procedure has already run in a VM episode.
